dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, this round table is really nice!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ðɪs ˈraʊnd ˈteɪbəl ɪz ˈriːli ˈnaɪs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. But it's too big, Emma.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. bʌt ɪts ˈtuː ˈbɪɡ, ˈɛmə.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And this one? Is it too big?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈðɪs wʌn? ɪz ɪt ˈtuː ˈbɪɡ?
